physicalAdmissibility.reason: The computed wetted liquid falls below vapour pressure. The prescribed detachment and closure do not resolve that additional cavitation region; this branch is numerical only. Pressure has not been clipped and the cavity has not been moved.
physicalAdmissibility.criterion: Cp + sigma = (p - pv)/qInfinity >= 0 on every sampled wetted panel; cavity BC panels are excluded.
physicalAdmissibility.scope: Equilibrium partial-sheet model consistency screen. Sensitive to discretisation near detachment and closure; not an experiment, accuracy estimate or empirical calibration.

metrics.pressureNote: Pressure residual uses a local five-point derivative of solved total potential within each boundary region (fewer points if needed), with one-sided stencils at detachment and closure. It compares to an imposed BC, not an experiment.

scope: Steady 2-D inviscid potential flow; prescribed upper partial-cavity length and detachment; algebraic pressure recovery; no re-entrant jet, viscosity, shedding, erosion or 3-D wing solution. Numerically verified prototype; cavitation predictions not experimentally validated.

provenance.formulation: Constant source/doublet mixed-potential BIE; cubic upstream detachment potential; legacy extrapolated Morino TE potential jump; fixed-x nonlinear cavity updates.
provenance.closure: q(s)=qc[1-A((sf-sT)/(sL-sT))^nu] in the recovery zone; sf is the original foil arclength. A, lambda and nu are model inputs, not fitted benchmark data.
